gates.name: Stock policy reproduction
gates.pass_condition: Reproduce the frozen checkpoint before any custom scene is interpreted.

gates.name: Primitive capability
gates.pass_condition: Every action exposed in the current core product scope has a one-sided 95% reliability lower bound of at least 0.80 in its declared context; the original 0.90 decision is reported as a stricter sensitivity check.
gates.current: ACT 100/100; T01 drawer-joint opening 97/100. This does not certify that the target became visible; that stricter requirement is FP3. ROTATE is excluded and remains 0/30.

gates.name: Prompt-conditioned belief
gates.pass_condition: An RGB-only model represents where prompt-relevant uncertainty lies and passes scene-disjoint prompt-swap calibration tests without target-pose, segmentation, or simulator-state inputs.
gates.current: PIU V0 emits a structured target-location distribution and passes 27/30 on old T01 diagnostic seeds. Only visible workspace and middle drawer are trained; object-level grounding, absent/other-region calibration, and scene-disjoint validation remain missing.

gates.name: Calibrated action-effect model
gates.pass_condition: For every enabled information action, predict the post-action observable effect from (prompt, observation, action), with class-conditional conformal coverage at least 0.90 on disjoint scenes.
gates.current: For T01 OPEN_AND_OBSERVE, the frozen v12b public-RGB critic passed fresh development (120 rows) and a one-time sealed audit (300 rows). Sealed FAILED and REVEALED are 100/100 singleton; EMPTY retains 99/100 correct labels and is singleton-correct 94/100 (lower 0.885). There are zero false singleton EMPTY or REVEALED predictions, mean set size 1.017, and 5/300 ambiguities route to SAFE_STOP. Physical REVEALED and local EMPTY effects are both 100/100 (lower 0.970); six-frame history retains 100/100 reveals versus 96/100 final-frame-only. Controller oracle reads are zero. FP3 remains PARTIAL because the pass condition requires disjoint scenes and every enabled information action, while current evidence is one T01 drawer context.

gates.name: Expected-risk optimizer
gates.pass_condition: Select ACT, information acquisition, or NOT_FOUND by minimizing expected prompt-conditioned task risk. Decision costs come from measured action cost and reliability or a preregistered sensitivity analysis; no tuned confidence-routing threshold is permitted.
gates.current: Finite-horizon Bayes-risk planning is implemented without a confidence threshold and routes 296/300 T01 counterfactuals for the target- observability endpoint. The current minimal runner bypasses probabilistic temporal q and uses hard-valid actions from deterministic phase, searched-set, and attempt-count memory. A five-case disposable PIU smoke now exercises live OPEN -> outcome -> belief update -> replan with explicit EIG/task utility and the 0.924 reliability lower bound. Final-task ACT risk is not ready: open-drawer retrieval is 0/5 and visible cream-cheese ACT is unmeasured.

gates.name: Oracle-free closed loop
gates.pass_condition: Audit the complete controller and show zero reads of simulator joints, segmentation, hidden target poses, or task predicates for routing, stopping, belief updates, and NOT_FOUND.
gates.current: Source/runtime guards pass for the OffScreen controller, the five-case v12b loop, and an actual original-prompt physical continuation. Every trace reports zero online oracle inputs; segmentation, joints, and task predicates are confined to evaluator replay after controller terminal. The full gate remains PARTIAL because PIU belief/effect inference is not yet scene-disjoint validated.

gates.name: Prompt-alignment counterfactuals
gates.pass_condition: On the same scene with different prompts, and the same prompt with different resolvable causes, the correct-decision reliability lower bound is at least 0.90 and the method beats prompt-blind fixed rules.
gates.current: The frozen T01 audit includes identical RGB with swapped prompts and the same prompt with closed/open state, and beats three prompt-blind rules. It does not yet cover different resolvable causes or held-out scenes.

gates.name: Multi-action information acquisition
gates.pass_condition: Reliably acquire the required information in at least three disjoint action families, with a one-sided 95% lower bound of at least 0.80 for each family; also report the original 0.90 decision.
gates.current: Full T01 OPEN_AND_OBSERVE is now certified for prompt-resolvable reveal and local-empty information effects on the sealed audit: both are 100/100 with lower 0.970 and pass the original 0.90 standard. Complete return is separately 199/200 because one EMPTY return timed out after the view was already certified. This is only one action family; viewpoint, removal, lift, and rotate remain uncertified.

gates.name: Final task completion
gates.pass_condition: After information acquisition, complete the original final task with a one-sided 95% reliability lower bound of at least 0.80 and a positive paired improvement over the monolithic VLA.
gates.current: Historical oracle-switched OPEN_CONTAINER -> ACT is 0/5. One new oracle-free disposable chain acquired information 1/1 and then failed the original physical task after a fixed 400-step ACT continuation 0/1. No positive paired final-task benefit is established.

gates.name: Abstention and exhaustion
gates.pass_condition: Correctly return NOT_FOUND only after calibrated search exhaustion, with at least 0.90 lower-bound reliability on both target-present and target-absent cases.
gates.current: NOT_FOUND has no certified executor or outcome calibration.

gates.name: Scene and policy generalization
gates.pass_condition: Pass object-, clutter-, occlusion-, and container-held-out tests and reproduce the decision benefit with a second frozen policy.
gates.current: Only the T01 pi0.5 reveal path is certified.

gates.name: Release and reproducibility
gates.pass_condition: One-command evaluation, pinned environment, frozen calibration hashes, complete failure demos, automated gate report, and clean GPU shutdown.
gates.current: One-command PIU behavior and physical-continuation runners, immutable model/data hashes, training scripts, clean/sealed outcome reports, visualization manifests, and oracle audits now exist. The object-level scene-disjoint V1 benchmark, clean paper runner, and final product matrix remain incomplete.
